scope: Proposition 3.5 of the manuscript “The Bogomolov-Pop reconstruction theorem” (preprints/The-Bogomolov-Pop-reconstruction-theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 009 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d805627401fffef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let K/k and L/l be function fields over algebraically closed fields of characteristic different from ℓ, each of transcendence degree at least two. Let φ : WL → WK be a continuous bracket-compatible Zℓ-module isomorphism. Then their transcendence degrees agree, say they are d. For every 1 ≤ r < d, the map φ carries exactly the pairs Iw ⊂ Dw of quasi-prime r-divisors of L/l onto the corresponding pairs of K/k. For matched pairs it induces a continuous isomorphism Dw/Iw ∼ = WLw −→ Dv/Iv ∼ = WKv that preserves alternating pairs.
